chunk_list: VERDANT CONNECTOR SECURITY REPORT V1.0 1. Summary The security review assessed authentication, authorization, networking, certificates, secrets, logs, temporary storage, dependencies, administration, updates, and incident response for the VERDANT connector. The conclusion is favorable with controls closed. The administration endpoint is limited to authorized networks, revoked certificates are rejected, logs remove sensitive headers, and products are not generated where the group contains fewer than three meters. 2. Scope The SolCentro, NEXUS, and Instituto Técnico do Norte connectors were reviewed together with their integration and pre-production configurations, API schemas, and deployment procedures. Tests used synthetic data and aggregated samples. 3. Method The review combined configuration analysis, contract tests, negative tests, log inspection, dependency scanning, and configuration restoration. Every finding has a severity, asset, evidence, owner, date, and closure test. 4. Result

No critical or high findings remain open. Two medium findings are temporarily accepted: manual rotation of one support credential and incomplete automation of an exception-expiry check. Both have an owner and date. Security result 1 Security domain 1 is authentication. Review identifies assets, threats, expected configuration, and evidence. At least one allowed and one denied test are executed. A documented configuration is not treated as a control where the deployed service permits different behavior.
